title: WII-UU: Turn any PC into a Wii U–style console (and your phone into the GamePad)

lines.say: This is Wii U U. It turns any computer, even a Raspberry Pi, into a console that looks and feels like the Wii U menu.
lines.text: This is WII-UU. It turns any computer, even a Raspberry Pi, into a console that looks and feels like the Wii U menu.

lines.say: And your phone becomes the GamePad.
lines.text: And your phone becomes the GamePad.

lines.say: Wii U U is a launcher. You drop your own games into a folder for each system, and they show up as tiles. Twenty consoles, from the NES to the Wii U and Switch, and from the PlayStation 1 to the PlayStation 4.
lines.text: WII-UU is a launcher. You drop your own games into a folder for each system, and they show up as tiles. Twenty consoles, from the NES to the Wii U and Switch, and from the PlayStation 1 to the PlayStation 4.

lines.say: It starts the right emulator for every game. And it has a dark mode, a start-up animation, and its own relaxed menu music.
lines.text: It starts the right emulator for every game. And it has a dark mode, a start-up animation, and its own relaxed menu music.

lines.say: Installing takes one line in a terminal, on Linux, macOS, or a Raspberry Pi. Windows gets a simple installer.
lines.text: Installing takes one line in a terminal, on Linux, macOS, or a Raspberry Pi. Windows gets a simple installer.

lines.say: On Linux, it can even download and set up the emulators for you.
lines.text: On Linux, it can even download and set up the emulators for you.

lines.say: To connect, press plus on the TV and scan the code with your phone. There's no app to install. The GamePad is a web page, and phones stay paired.
lines.text: To connect, press + on the TV and scan the code with your phone. There's no app to install: the GamePad is a web page, and phones stay paired.

lines.say: Now the D-pad and the buttons on your phone move around the menu on the TV.
lines.text: Now the D-pad and the buttons on your phone move around the menu on the TV.

lines.say: Tap a game on your phone, and it starts on the TV. Press HOME, and close it, just like on a Wii U.
lines.text: Tap a game on your phone, and it starts on the TV. Press HOME and close it, just like on a Wii U.

lines.say: The phone's screen isn't just a remote. It can mirror the TV, live.
lines.text: The phone's screen isn't just a remote. It can mirror the TV, live.

lines.say: With Wii U games, the GamePad view moves to your phone. For DS and 3DS games, you get the touch screen. And gyro and the PC's sound work too.
lines.text: With Wii U games, the GamePad view moves to your phone. For DS and 3DS games, you get the touch screen. And gyro and the PC's sound work too.

lines.say: On Linux, every phone becomes a real virtual controller that emulators detect on their own.
lines.text: On Linux, every phone becomes a real virtual controller that emulators detect on their own.

lines.say: On Mac and Windows, Wii U U types keys instead. And for Dolphin, PCSX2 and DuckStation, it writes a temporary controller mapping while a game runs, then puts your own settings back. So the buttons just work.
lines.text: On Mac and Windows, WII-UU types keys instead. And for Dolphin, PCSX2 and DuckStation, it writes a temporary controller mapping while a game runs, then puts your own settings back. So the buttons just work.

lines.say: Prefer RetroArch? Turn on RetroArch mode, and every system with a core runs there. Missing cores download by themselves.
lines.text: Prefer RetroArch? Turn on RetroArch mode, and every system with a core runs there. Missing cores download by themselves.

lines.say: And with Console Mode, a PC or a Raspberry Pi boots straight into Wii U U, like a Steam Deck. Desktop mode is always one button away.
lines.text: And with Console Mode, a PC or a Raspberry Pi boots straight into WII-UU, like a Steam Deck. Desktop Mode is always one button away.

lines.say: Wii U U is free. The link is in the description. Have fun!
lines.text: WII-UU is free. The link is in the description. Have fun!
